title: Web development: HTML, CSS and PHP
summary: 60 lessons build accessible documents, responsive interfaces and tested PHP applications, from a first page to secure request handling and a deliberate deployment plan. HTML/CSS previews run offline; PHP examples use an isolated Linux CLI worker.

lessons.title: A web page: source, browser and server
lessons.outcome: Trace a requested page from source to visible output.
lessons.lab: Build a complete document with a title, one heading and two paragraphs.
lessons.verification: The preview contains one main heading and two paragraphs in a main region.

lessons.title: Elements, attributes, nesting and text escaping
lessons.outcome: Explain escaping versus validation with a text and URL example.
lessons.lab: Build a notes paragraph with nested importance and literal angle brackets.
lessons.verification: The structure remains a paragraph and the comparison is text rather than an element.

lessons.title: Semantic structure, headings and landmarks
lessons.outcome: Explain when a div is more appropriate than section.
lessons.lab: Build a study page with landmarks and a working skip link.
lessons.verification: Header, labeled navigation, one main and footer have meaningful content; the skip target exists.

lessons.title: Links, paths, navigation and usable destinations
lessons.outcome: Explain the difference between absolute, root-relative and document-relative paths.
lessons.lab: Build a contents list that navigates to three local sections.
lessons.verification: Every fragment matches one unique section id and works with keyboard activation.

lessons.title: Lists, quotations, code and meaningful text
lessons.outcome: Explain the difference between preserving whitespace and preserving meaning.
lessons.lab: Build a study checklist with a code example and glossary.
lessons.verification: The page exposes list, code and definition structures without relying on spacing.

lessons.title: Images, SVG, alternatives and media decisions
lessons.outcome: Plan an accessible video lesson without autoplay.
lessons.lab: Create an offline SVG progress illustration with a textual equivalent.
lessons.verification: The image has an accessible name and the numeric progress is visible as text.

lessons.title: Data tables, captions and header relationships
lessons.outcome: Explain when a chart should keep a supporting table.
lessons.lab: Build a three-row study table with correct header relationships.
lessons.verification: The caption, row headers and column headers identify every value.

lessons.title: Forms: labels, controls and successful values
lessons.outcome: Explain why form appearance cannot establish server validation.
lessons.lab: Build a study-preferences form with three native control types.
lessons.verification: Every control has a useful label, stable name and suitable type.

lessons.title: Form constraints, errors and helpful recovery
lessons.outcome: Separate client feedback from server-side acceptance.
lessons.lab: Build a bounded study-time form with linked help.
lessons.verification: The user can identify the rule, enter a valid value and retain it after a failed attempt.

lessons.title: CSS rules, selectors and the cascade
lessons.outcome: Explain why specificity alone does not describe the cascade.
lessons.lab: Style two note cards using one low-specificity class.
lessons.verification: Both cards share styling without duplicate ids or inline declarations.

lessons.title: The box model, sizing and overflow
lessons.outcome: Explain which dimensions margin does and does not affect.
lessons.lab: Build a readable card that contains a long identifier.
lessons.verification: The identifier wraps or scrolls locally without overflowing the page.

lessons.title: Typography, units and readable content
lessons.outcome: Explain why ch is a useful approximation rather than a word-count guarantee.
lessons.lab: Build a reading page with bounded measure and scalable headings.
lessons.verification: Text stays comfortable at wide and narrow sizes without fixed-height clipping.

lessons.title: Color, contrast, focus and accessible states
lessons.outcome: Explain why one palette check does not qualify every interaction state.
lessons.lab: Build status cards whose meaning does not depend on color.
lessons.verification: Each card contains a clear label, readable text and visible interactive focus.

lessons.title: Normal flow, display and positioning
lessons.outcome: Explain the containing block used by an absolute element.
lessons.lab: Build a card with an intentional positioned badge and flowing content.
lessons.verification: Long body text expands the card while the badge stays in its reserved corner.

lessons.title: Flexbox: one-dimensional layout and resilient navigation
lessons.outcome: Explain when Flexbox fits better than Grid.
lessons.lab: Build a wrapping navigation bar and flexible card row.
lessons.verification: Long labels stay reachable at narrow widths and DOM order remains logical.

lessons.title: Grid: tracks, gaps and two-dimensional alignment
lessons.outcome: Explain auto-fit versus auto-fill at a high level.
lessons.lab: Build an adaptive topic grid that survives a narrow container.
lessons.verification: Cards change column count while preserving reading order and avoiding page overflow.

lessons.title: Responsive layouts and content-driven breakpoints
lessons.outcome: Explain why responsive design is more than media queries.
lessons.lab: Build a responsive course outline with a readable article.
lessons.verification: The page adapts between stacked and two-column layouts without losing content.

lessons.title: Custom properties, tokens and component themes
lessons.outcome: Explain a token name that survives a palette change.
lessons.lab: Build two themed cards using one component rule.
lessons.verification: The variants preserve content labels, contrast and focus while sharing structure.

lessons.title: Pseudo-classes, pseudo-elements and stateful styling
lessons.outcome: Explain why CSS state cannot authorize a server action.
lessons.lab: Build a preferences list whose selected state is visible and semantic.
lessons.verification: Native checkboxes carry the state and text styling reinforces it.

lessons.title: Transitions, motion and reduced-motion preferences
lessons.outcome: Explain why transform does not guarantee a fast page.
lessons.lab: Build a card interaction with a static reduced-motion alternative.
lessons.verification: The card remains understandable and usable without movement.

lessons.title: Container queries and reusable responsive components
lessons.outcome: Choose between a viewport query and a container query for a sidebar card.
lessons.lab: Render the same component in wide and narrow slots.
lessons.verification: Each instance adapts independently while preserving its content.

lessons.title: CSS architecture, layers and maintainable components
lessons.outcome: Explain why important declarations complicate layer reasoning.
lessons.lab: Build a small layered stylesheet with base, component and utility rules.
lessons.verification: The intended overrides work without escalating ids or important flags.

lessons.title: Print styles, progressive enhancement and resilient delivery
lessons.outcome: Explain what a feature query proves and what it does not.
lessons.lab: Build printable study notes with a useful baseline layout.
lessons.verification: Screen and print views preserve meaning with appropriate presentation.

lessons.title: HTML and CSS milestone: an accessible learning portal
lessons.outcome: Explain the portal's remaining backend requirements.
lessons.lab: Build a complete offline portal with three paths and local destinations.
lessons.verification: All cards, navigation and headings are meaningful, keyboard reachable and responsive.

lessons.title: Connect HTML to JavaScript: DOM, events and safe text
lessons.outcome: Explain why reading state back from formatted text is fragile.
lessons.lab: Build a native-button counter with a reset action and output.
lessons.verification: Increment and reset work by keyboard and pointer, with a visible announced result.

lessons.title: Disclosures, dialogs and focus management
lessons.outcome: Explain why a modal is inappropriate for every small message.
lessons.lab: Build a disclosure and a deliberately opened local dialog.
lessons.verification: Both are labeled, keyboard operable and can be closed without losing the task.

lessons.title: Accessible form feedback with a pure validation function
lessons.outcome: Explain which validation logic must be repeated on the server.
lessons.lab: Build a local form with preserved input and linked validation feedback.
lessons.verification: A failed attempt identifies the problem without clearing the user's value.

lessons.title: Data interfaces: filtering tables and honest visual summaries
lessons.outcome: Explain how this table connects to D3 without changing the statistical claim.
lessons.lab: Build a filterable local study table with an explicit empty state.
lessons.verification: Changing the selection updates rows and count while preserving the original data.

lessons.title: Browser trust boundaries: text, origins and policy
lessons.outcome: Explain the separate roles of escaping, validation, CSP and sandboxing.
lessons.lab: Build a small rendering demo that separates text handling from URL policy.
lessons.verification: Plain text remains data and navigation candidates pass an explicit scheme decision.

lessons.title: Browser quality: tests, performance and independent review
lessons.outcome: Explain what evidence would justify a production readiness claim.
lessons.lab: Create a quality report for the portal from web-024.
lessons.verification: The report records source revision, tested conditions, observations and remaining limitations.

lessons.title: PHP begins: interpreter, CLI and server execution
lessons.outcome: Compare the CLI lifecycle with a server request lifecycle.
lessons.lab: Write a PHP program that prints a study topic and computed duration.
lessons.verification: The program runs in the CLI worker and produces two clearly labeled values.

lessons.title: Values, types, strict comparisons and null
lessons.outcome: Explain the limited scope of strict_types.
lessons.lab: Model an optional note without confusing missing, empty and null.
lessons.verification: The program documents and checks the chosen interpretation of each state.

lessons.title: Expressions, integer money and deliberate conversion
lessons.outcome: Explain when integer cents are insufficient.
lessons.lab: Implement a bounded quantity calculation and cents formatter.
lessons.verification: Valid quantities produce exact integer totals and two-digit fractional display.

lessons.title: Conditions, loops and bounded control flow
lessons.outcome: Explain match versus switch for a typed mapping.
lessons.lab: Build a bounded weekly-duration summary with a route label.
lessons.verification: The total and label follow the declared cases and terminate predictably.

lessons.title: Arrays, records, keys and transformations
lessons.outcome: Explain the risk of a lingering foreach reference.
lessons.lab: Filter and summarize study records without changing the originals.
lessons.verification: The derived list contains only qualifying rows and retains consecutive indices.

lessons.title: Functions, contracts, closures and reusable logic
lessons.outcome: Explain when a closure improves a transformation.
lessons.lab: Build reusable duration calculation and display functions.
lessons.verification: Calculations can be tested without capturing output, then formatted at the boundary.

lessons.title: Strings, UTF-8, bytes and contextual encoding
lessons.outcome: Explain validation, normalization and output escaping separately.
lessons.lab: Build a text inspection report that labels bytes honestly.
lessons.verification: The program does not present strlen as a count of user-perceived characters.

lessons.title: Structured data, streams and bounded file handling
lessons.outcome: Explain why user-controlled paths need an ownership policy.
lessons.lab: Parse a small study record and round-trip it through a temporary stream.
lessons.verification: The field contract passes and the returned bytes match the encoded value.

lessons.title: Exceptions, errors and useful failure boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain the difference between learner diagnostics and public production errors.
lessons.lab: Build a failure-aware parser with explicit success and error paths.
lessons.verification: Valid data returns a result; invalid data produces a clear classified failure.

lessons.title: Objects, constructors and immutable value boundaries
lessons.outcome: Explain shallow readonly versus deep immutability.
lessons.lab: Build a validated study-session value object.
lessons.verification: Its topic and duration satisfy explicit constructor checks and remain readonly.

lessons.title: Interfaces, composition and replaceable dependencies
lessons.outcome: Explain what remains untested by an in-memory repository.
lessons.lab: Build a summary service with an injected repository.
lessons.verification: The same service works with two controlled implementations that satisfy the interface.

lessons.title: Namespaces, project layout and Composer boundaries
lessons.outcome: Describe a deliberate dependency update and lockfile review.
lessons.lab: Design a small project layout with source, tests and a public entrypoint.
lessons.verification: Application code and tests stay separate from the server's public document root.

lessons.title: Dates, time zones and deterministic clocks
lessons.outcome: Explain why a numeric offset is not a complete regional time-zone rule.
lessons.lab: Build a deterministic study-session time report.
lessons.verification: The output uses explicit time zones and a fixed input suitable for repeatable tests.

lessons.title: Testing PHP: examples, boundaries and contract evidence
lessons.outcome: Explain why a passing reference is not a bug-free guarantee.
lessons.lab: Create a test table for a bounded study-duration function.
lessons.verification: Normal, zero, invalid and boundary cases have independently justified outcomes.

lessons.title: Templates and context-specific output escaping
lessons.outcome: Explain why validated text still needs output escaping.
lessons.lab: Render a study-card template from synthetic untrusted labels.
lessons.verification: The structure stays fixed while labels are escaped at output.

lessons.title: HTTP requests, response models and routing
lessons.outcome: Explain what a CLI response model does not prove.
lessons.lab: Build a pure router for health and lesson-summary requests.
lessons.verification: Known GET routes return their declared representations and unsupported requests are rejected.

lessons.title: Server form validation and redisplay without data loss
lessons.outcome: Explain the limits of POST redirect GET.
lessons.lab: Build a validator returning cleaned values and field-specific errors.
lessons.verification: Valid data has a complete domain value; invalid data has actionable errors and no partial write.

lessons.title: Cookies, sessions and a request-to-request lifecycle
lessons.outcome: Describe a real HTTP session acceptance test.
lessons.lab: Model session activity and expiry with explicit state transitions.
lessons.verification: An expired session is rejected and a valid activity update preserves the declared identity.

lessons.title: CSRF defenses and deliberate state-changing requests
lessons.outcome: Explain the relationship between CSRF, SameSite and XSS.
lessons.lab: Build a state-change decision that checks method, token and authorization.
lessons.verification: Only a deliberate allowed POST with matching token can reach the mutation branch.

lessons.title: Password hashing and authentication boundaries
lessons.outcome: List the additional controls required around a real login.
lessons.lab: Build a password-verification demonstration without printing the hash or secret.
lessons.verification: The output reports the test result while keeping credential-shaped values out of logs.

lessons.title: PDO, prepared statements and the value-query boundary
lessons.outcome: Explain which checks must be repeated when moving to PostgreSQL.
lessons.lab: Build a local PDO note store with prepared insert and lookup.
lessons.verification: The expected record is retrieved and SQL-looking text remains data.

lessons.title: Transactions, constraints and concurrent changes
lessons.outcome: Explain the limits of the single-connection concurrency demonstration.
lessons.lab: Implement a version-checked update in a disposable database.
lessons.verification: The first expected version succeeds and the repeated stale version affects zero rows.

lessons.title: Authorization, ownership and object-level access
lessons.outcome: Explain why hiding an edit button is only a user-interface convenience.
lessons.lab: Build an object-access function with separate trusted actor and requested id inputs.
lessons.verification: The owner can read the record and a different actor receives no record.

lessons.title: JSON APIs, schemas and consistent error responses
lessons.outcome: Explain a backward-compatible versus breaking API change.
lessons.lab: Build a response model that maps success and validation failure consistently.
lessons.verification: Status, content type and JSON body agree with the declared contract.

lessons.title: Pagination, caching and bounded application workloads
lessons.outcome: Explain what must be measured before claiming a faster database endpoint.
lessons.lab: Implement a cursor-based slice over synthetic records.
lessons.verification: The second page continues after the last id and the final page can be shorter.

lessons.title: PHP milestone: a tested study-planner application core
lessons.outcome: Explain the remaining work before this core becomes a deployed application.
lessons.lab: Build a tested planner core with validation and prepared storage.
lessons.verification: Accepted plans persist in the disposable database and rejected inputs create no rows.

lessons.title: A real local HTTP lab: sessions, forms and persistent notes
lessons.outcome: Explain which properties this local server has not qualified.
lessons.lab: Run the owned lab and create one synthetic note through the browser.
lessons.verification: The note survives a page reload and appears after a successful POST-redirect-GET sequence.

lessons.title: Uploads, filesystem ownership and outbound side effects
lessons.outcome: Explain which tests are needed before enabling uploads or email.
lessons.lab: Write an upload design with separate validation, storage and retrieval boundaries.
lessons.verification: Files receive generated names, stay outside executable public paths and have ownership and retention rules.

lessons.title: Deploying PHP: containers, web servers and operations
lessons.outcome: Explain what evidence is needed before publishing an image as ready.
lessons.lab: Design a release plan for the study planner with durable storage.
lessons.verification: The plan covers configuration, secrets, migration, health, write/read acceptance, backup and rollback.

lessons.title: Integrated capstone: accessible, tested and recoverable web learning
lessons.outcome: Present a release-readiness review with explicit limits and next actions.
lessons.lab: Build and review a learner-owned extension of the supplied local lab.
lessons.verification: The extension has coherent HTML/CSS, tested PHP behavior and a bounded reproducible setup.
